title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (16/20): Offshore Wind Farms
note_en: 起来 after a verb can mark the moment an action gets going and what follows from it: 转动起来可以覆盖的面积相当于好几个足球场 "once they start turning, they sweep an area as big as several soccer fields." English needs "once" or "when" to set up the condition, but Chinese builds it into the verb itself with 起来, so no separate clause marker is needed.
